data.title: These  dinos soar
data.description: <p>The original Jurassic Park (1993) set such a high bar for every dinosaur movie franchise that followed, even fans of dinosaur films admit that the modern sequels have never quite been able to replicate the magic of Spielberg's original masterpiece.</p>

data.title: CP Innovation Center of Excellence’s new platform cements global hub status
data.description: BANGKOK, August 13, 2026 — Charoen Pokphand Group (CP Group) has announced the launch of CP-CoEX (Center of Excellence x Exponential), signalling the next phase of its twofold strategy of developing people and creating innovation in response to the major technological changes impacting the world. CP-CoEX is a global learning and innovation platform that connects leaders and experts from tech businesses and universities around the world to address real challenges presently facing the industrial sector. The announcement further consolidates the status of the hosting CP Innovation Center of Excellence (CPIC) as a hub for innovation, learning and the acquisition of future skills.

data.title: We know U-Know is coming to town
data.description: <p>U-Know from the K-pop boy band TVXQ! marks a new chapter in artistic evolution with his first full-scale solo concert in Thailand, "U-Know Project 26: Scene#1 In Bangkok", on Aug 29 at Phenix Grand Ballroom, Phetchaburi Road.</p>

data.title: Thailand to Host 29th ASEAN Labour Ministers’ Meeting
data.description: Thailand is set to host the 29th ASEAN Labour Ministers Meeting and Related Meetings (ALMM), reaffirming its commitment to advancing regional workforce development. Held under the theme, “Advancing ASEAN Human Capital: Skills Certification towards Global Recognition,” the Meeting will bring together the 11 ASEAN Member States to strengthen cooperation in enhancing the skills, mobility, and competitiveness of more than 357 million workers across the region.

data.title: Limited edition Big Pilot flies high in Ceralume
data.description: <p>Since the mid 1980s, IWC Schaffhausen has built extensive expertise on ceramic technology. Its engineering division XPL took several years to develop Ceralume, achieving another milestone in 2025 with the innovative material debuting on a concept watch.</p>

data.title: Pluak Daeng becomes ‘Little Guangzhou’ as Rayong weighs tighter controls
data.description: Chinese investment is transforming Pluak Daeng in Rayong, lifting land prices while raising concerns over zoning, utilities and local businesses.

data.title: ONE Championship: Nontachai ruled out with illness as Nabati fight is scrapped
data.description: Kiamran Nabati’s ONE Fight Night 46 bout with Nontachai Jitmuangnon was scrapped on Thursday after the Thai fell ill, went to hospital and did not receive medical clearance.

data.title: Hunt bags Euro sprint double, Ceh keeps discus title
data.description: BIRMINGHAM (UNITED KINGDOM) - Briton Amy Hunt claimed a memorable European sprint double after scorching to victory in the 200m in Birmingham on Thursday on a night when Germany claimed five medals, including two golds.

data.title: Vance says low oil prices are top US goal in Iran conflict
data.description: WASHINGTON (UNITED STATES) - Vice President JD Vance said Thursday that the top US priority in the Iran war was keeping oil and gasoline prices low for Americans, with preventing Tehran from acquiring a nuclear weapon ranking second.

data.title: US, Mexico conduct security exercises near border
data.description: CIUDAD JUáREZ (MEXICO) - US and Mexican armed forces performed security exercises Thursday along the border near the cities of El Paso and Ciudad Juarez.

data.title: UK vote count under way in Farage, Binface showdown
data.description: CLACTON-ON-SEA (UNITED KINGDOM) - Vote counting was under way early on Friday after an unusual English by-election shunned by mainstream parties, pitting influential hard-right leader Nigel Farage against Count Binface, a man with a rubbish bin on his head.

data.title: New trend of injecting banned peptides to 'optimise' body
data.description: PARIS (FRANCE) - Thomas's phone alarm buzzes at 9:30 pm -- it's time for the aspiring bodybuilder to start injecting himself in the stomach with several banned peptides.

data.title: 'Shock' gloves for US immigration agents fuel potential abuse fears
data.description: WASHINGTON (UNITED STATES) - Plans to equip US immigration enforcement agents with gloves capable of delivering debilitating electric shocks have fueled concerns over potential abuses by a force that critics say is already over-zealous and under-trained.

data.title: Trump announces tariffs of up to 100% on imported drones
data.description: WASHINGTON (UNITED STATES) - President Donald Trump announced on Thursday tariffs of up to 100 percent on imports of unmanned drones and their components to reduce US reliance on imports in an industry dominated by China.

data.title: Building Confidence with 'Dr. Phed' of Fiora Clinic
data.description: Bangkok, Thailand – As Thailand steps up to become the Medical and Wellness Hub of the Asia-Pacific (APAC) region, expats residing in this region, as well as high-end travelers, are increasingly seeking premium, safe, and highly personalized beauty services. Standing at the forefront of this rapidly growing industry is Dr. Chairat Sermsilp (Dr. Petch, Medical License: 45095), an expert aesthetic physician and executive of Fiora Clinic .

data.title: TrueVisions NOW Partners with Viu in Major Media Milestone
data.description: From stories created by Thai talent to new opportunities in the regional content market, TrueVisions NOW, Thailand’s leading streaming platform and entertainment content provider, has announced a strategic partnership with Viu, a leading regional OTT video streaming platform. Through this collaboration, the two companies are launching the “TrueVisions NOW Branded Zone,” an exclusive content hub on Viu showcasing quality original series from TrueVisions NOW. The partnership will initially bring six original series from a slate of 24 titles to Viu audiences in Malaysia, Indonesia, and the Philippines. This partnership marks another important milestone for TrueVisions NOW as it evolves from creating content for Thai audiences to expanding its regional reach and unlocking new opportunities for Thai IP in international markets. It also reinforces TrueVisions NOW’s commitment to bringing Thai creativity, distinctive cultural identity, and compelling storytelling to a broader audience across the region.
